intercepts.description: Camera coord+euler write -- rsi = camera struct base. Coords at 0x0, look (euler) at 0x0C, FOV at 0x08.

camera_write_profile._comment: rsi = camera struct at intercept. CryEngine stores look data as euler float3 (pitch/yaw/roll) at 0x0C. Coords at 0x0. FOV at 0x08 (verify -- same offset as z coord per IGCS notes; likely separate FOV struct).
